notes:
Session 14 — AES dry-run pipeline + lessons learned analysis.

Dry-run approach: Workflow agent() with isolation:'worktree' bypasses the test-brief trust blocker.
AES formula: compliance(0.3) + file_efficiency(0.25) + deliverable_ratio(0.25) + test_discipline(0.1) + context_discipline(0.1).
Baseline AES: 31.5. Target: 80.
Baseline metrics: compliance 71%, file efficiency 23%, deliverable ratio 7%, test runs 13 (limit 2), context growth 440%.

Dry-run AES (workflow brief-test): 32.75.
Dry-run metrics: compliance 50% (5/10), file efficiency 22% (2/9), deliverable ratio 9%, test runs 4 (2 full + 2 targeted), context growth 153%.
Flags: TDD_SEQUENCE_VIOLATED, SHARED-02 (dup reads), SHARED-03 (cat via bash), M-03 (test runs), M-04 (no governing spec), M-06 (no grep before read).
All 10 reads marked unused — 0% read utility. Brief rules aren't producing behavior change yet.

Key decisions this session:
- DRY_RUN should flow through full pipeline but skip commit/push/PR/heal
- Workflow agent() with isolation:'worktree' is the solution for worktree trust (auto-trusts)
- AES ≥ 80 must gate commits — quality violations block shipping
- Process violations → brief heal only, quality violations → remediation pass
- All AES dimensions must hit 80%+ (compliance, file efficiency, deliverable ratio, test discipline, context discipline)

Suite: 1304 pass, 0 fail, 72 files. 39/60 SCs done.
antipatterns: Do NOT write hand-wired phase tests — use conformity engine
Do NOT edit PROJECT-STATE.md directly — edit project-state.json
Do NOT hardcode template strings in scaffold — externalize to template files
Do NOT put deep logic in hooks — extract to lib/, hook is thin trigger
Do NOT use agentType in workflows — use briefedAgent() with role from config
Do NOT tell agents 'read your Context section' — parse it and generate explicit Read steps
Do NOT write freeform SC text — use create-sc CLI (once built) or matchable patterns from SPEC-TEMPLATE
Do NOT rely on CLAUDE.md for procedural enforcement — use hooks or /ship
Do NOT let context drift — refresh rules mid-session via Bash cat of CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md
Do NOT stop the session for a single blocker — log it to the issue, move to next priority, summarize all blockers at session end
Do NOT ask Jason when the spec has clear ACs — decide, note the decision, keep moving
Do NOT load prompt files that agents ignore — every loaded file must have testable rules that produce measurable behavior change
Do NOT write vague rules like 'one export per concern' — write specific checkable rules like 'each file has at most 3 export statements'
Do NOT run Quinn on CLI projects — check pages:{} in rungate.json before spawning
Do NOT hand-write eval configs — derive evals from the source rule files automatically
Do NOT ship code without AES ≥ 80 — quality violations block commit, process violations get brief heal
